'''Opal''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Frozen Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

==Bundles==
Opal is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Opal is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Opal is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt062.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Opal is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].
